topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: Found your old pal, the plush one, at a yard sale, huh? That's some coincidence. Or maybe not. This city, it's got a way of spitting out the past when you least expect it. Like some kind of twisted karma. I didn't know you had such a soft spot for stuffed animals, never took you for the sentimental type. But then again, people, they change. Sometimes they hold onto things tighter than ever, trying to claw their way back to a time when the world wasn’t so damn cold. You thinking about childhood, or about that yard sale? There’s always a catch, always a reason things like this happen. I’ve seen it before, and it never ends pretty. Let’s see what this bear has to say for itself.
